name: electron v44.8.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.8.0

## Features

* Added support for `Notification` action buttons on Linux. [#54890](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54890) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54889))</sup>

## Fixes

* Fixed mouse cursor missing over native dialogs in certain scenarios on Windows. [#54987](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54987)
* Fixed `net.fetch` and `session.fetch` failing permanently with `net::ERR_FAILED` after the Network Service process restarts. [#54909](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54909) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54925), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54908), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54910))</sup>
* Fixed `utilityProcess` dropping messages posted with `process.parentPort.postMessage()` right before the process exits. [#54960](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54960) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55000), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54962), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54956))</sup>
* Fixed `win.isFullScreen()` being stale in fullscreen events on Windows. [#55009](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55009) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55008))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream Chromium and V8. [#55034](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55034)
* Updated Chromium to 152.0.7977.167. [#54928](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54928)
* Updated Node.js to v24.22.0. [#55004](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55004)
